dog.description_text:
Pop Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Amber!
Amber is a sweet, easygoing girl who is happy to say hello and even happier when you have treats to share. She was found as a stray, so we're still getting to know her, but she's already showing us that she's a friendly, gentle companion who enjoys spending time with her people. This lovely lady is ready to find a home where she can settle in and start her next chapter.

My Ideal Home
Amber would love a home where she can enjoy plenty of walks, fun adventures, and quality time with her favorite people. She's an easygoing girl who will benefit from daily exercise and enrichment like food puzzles, long-lasting chews, and games that keep her clever mind busy. She seems to have a nice, balanced energy level and is ready to be your new walking buddy.

Good with Other Pets?
Amber's history with other dogs is unknown, and her recent assessment didn't give us a clear answer just yet. She'll appreciate slow, thoughtful introductions as she gets to know any potential dog friends.

Good with Kids?
Amber's history with children is unknown, but she's been friendly and receptive with the people she's met here. As always, calm and respectful introductions will help everyone get off to a great start.

Things to Know
Amber walks with only mild pulling, readily approaches her handler, and happily accepts treats and gentle attention. She isn't especially interested in toys, but she seems to enjoy simply being with her people and exploring what's around her. This sweet girl may not need to be the center of attention to steal your heart, but we're pretty sure she'll do it anyway.
dog.name: Amber
